acceptance: evolve ci telemetry reads spawns.ndjson from a CI run and reports pkg.spawns.git and pkg.spawns.go per package.
A package with no spawn lines reports 0, and a run with no spawns.ndjson reports the fields as absent, not 0.
fix: Add the spawn-count reader to the CI telemetry report, next to the rusage and sampler readers, keyed by TESTRUSAGE_PKG.
